title: Origins of Preservation Hall and the Jaffes' arrival in 1961
summary: Jaffe tells how Larry Borenstein's gallery hosted informal sessions, then how he and Sandy arrived in March 1961, met musicians and Ken Mills, and began helping at the Sunday afternoon sessions that became nightly concerts.
